caption: A lit candle is carried down a dark staircase, and the light on the walls travels with the candle.

sa.check: A lit candle is carried down a staircase.
The light on the walls travels with the candle.

pc.expect: The walls are brightest near the flame and darken behind as the candle moves on.
pc.fail: The light stays put while the candle moves; or walls stay lit behind; or light appears ahead.

pc.expect: The lit area moves only with the candle and flickers only with the flame.
pc.fail: It drifts with the candle still; or pulses with a steady flame; or jumps.
It points down or sideways in still air; or detaches; or floats.

pc.expect: Shadows on the walls point away from the flame.
pc.fail: They point toward it; or in several directions; or there are none.
A second flame appears; or the candle vanishes; or the light becomes solid.
The steps change; or the walls change colour rather than brightness; or the candle changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
